description.en: Returns the handle of a character within the current soccer match/battle context, analogous to CMND_GET_CHARA_HANDLE but resolved against the active match's roster. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Identifier of the character within the match/battle context.
Handle of the requested battle character.

example.code:
// Get the handle of battle character index 0 during a match event
local hBtlChara = CMND_GET_BTLCHARA_HANDLE(0);
